svg.title: Conda environment verification workload
svg.desc: A scatter plot shows predicted review probability by dust index for 60 held-out fictional inspections. A confusion matrix shows 28 correct no-review predictions, 2 false review alerts, 4 missed review cases, and 26 correct review predictions. Accuracy is 0.900 and review recall is 0.867.
